rows.coder_note: 'UK Biobank (UKB) Pharma Proteomics Project (N=54,219)': the project name is shared by the discovery, replication, full-cohort and ancestry-specific rows, and 54,219 is the sample size of none of them; no subcohort, citation or accession (rules D, I1).

'deCODE genetics (N=35,559)': the N equals that of deCODE SomaScan v4 (Ferkingstad 2021), but it stands with the cohort name alone, with no platform, year or citation; exact counts with a cohort name alone are release_not_identified (rule I1).
